tools.name: mcw-get-board
tools.description: The current crypto news board: mood, counts, the top stories by market impact, and the AI digest. This is what www.mooncatcherwire.com shows.

tools.name: mcw-get-story
tools.description: One story in full by its id, including TSP's own review state and the Moon Catcher Wire editor state if one has been set.

tools.name: mcw-search
tools.description: Case-insensitive search over headlines and summaries of the current board.

tools.name: mcw-list-topics
tools.description: The Moon Catcher Wire topics and the rules behind them. These are ours: TSP classifies only by ticker, so a topic like "ai" is not representable upstream and is a keyword rule over the headline and summary here.

tools.name: mcw-get-digest
tools.description: The AI-written market digest for the current board: overview, the bull/neutral/bear split, per-ticker takeaways and the clustered highlights.
